notes.title: Christmas Update - Let the horrors continue!
notes.notes:
[b]Shared[/b]
[list]
[*]Donation Status and End Game Achievement checks is now done on the server and is checked whenever you spawn in-game.
[*]You no longer need to double click in order to activate items in the inventory.
[*]Fixed a bug related to keyboard bindings, left-hand designed keyboards would be unable to bind right-shift, rctrl, etc...
[*]You will no longer need to erase your saves when you want to start over again. (chapter selection)
[/list]
[b]Linux & OSX[/b]
[list]
[*]The chapter title overlay and the boss bar will now display properly.
[*]Fixed thirdperson idle anim for the grenade.
[/list]

notes.title: New Patch - V2.8 Major Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]I'm pleased to announce that many hair ripping issues has been fixed:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed Kitchen Cut Scene View/Dialogue Issue
[*] Raised Damage on the P38, MP40 & G43
[*] Fixed an issue with the FG-42, you couldn't pick it up/unlock it despite having the achievement necessary
[*] Removed bullet tracers while ironsighted
[*] Fixed the common crash many has experienced, the crash was caused by dropping inventory items.
[*] Hopefully fixed an issue preventing people to get to the main menu (on launch)
[*] Fixed an issue related to subtitles
[*] Some music and other generic sounds weren't affected by the music or game volume, this has now been fixed
[*] Changed the Stephano Collectible pickup sound
[*] Added a new easter egg in the Kitchen area... And NO, it's not a PewDiePie easter egg...
[/list]

[h1]IMPORTANT:[/h1]
Due to a big change in the inventory items server side logic using your previous saves might come in conflict with the new items (only dropped items).

Best Regards,
Bernt

- Enjoy

notes.title: New Patch - V2.6 Update
notes.notes:
Another minor update!
Fixes/Changes in v2.6:

- Changed the loading screen to now show a full screen image of the map instead of a poster with 3 random images from the map.
- Increased console interpolation speed. ( Opening / Closing )
- Voice Over on Notes will fade in faster.
- Voice Over on USING inventory items has been removed.
- The USE & DROP button in the inventory is now more clearly visible.
- Removed a bugged startup argument on the game launch options...

Enjoy!

Best Regards, 
Bernt.

notes.title: A minor patch has been released!
notes.notes:
A minor update has been released, this fixes the following:

Inventory Issues at generally small resolutions.
Especially 4:3 and 16:10 ratio resolutions!
These issues would prevent people from either seeing items, overlapping or even seeing the use/drop buttons. I recommend ya'll to apply this one and then continue playing! 

:)

Best Regards,
Bernt.
